id: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you. Which do you want to know about?
en: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you.  Which do you want to know about?
it: \bQuindi vuoi sapere dei Pokémon che un tempo si evolvevano tramite scambio? Te lo spiego io. Di quale vuoi sapere?

id: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter, Boldore, Gurdurr, Phantump, and Pumpkaboo evolve at level 35.
en: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter, Boldore, Gurdurr, Phantump, and Pumpkaboo evolve at level 35.
it: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter, Boldore, Gurdurr, Phantump e Pumpkaboo si evolvono al livello 35.

id: \bPoliwhirl and Slowpoke evolve in the day when holding a King's Rock. Onix at day with a Metal Coat. Porygon at day with an Upgrade.
en: \bPoliwhirl and Slowpoke evolve in the day when holding a King's Rock. Onix at day with a Metal Coat.  Porygon at day with an Upgrade.
it: \bPoliwhirl e Slowpoke si evolvono di giorno se tengono una Roccia di Re. Onix di giorno con una Metalcoperta. Porygon di giorno con un Upgrade.

id: \bClamperl at day with a Deep Sea Scale. Feebas at day with a Prism Scale.
en: \bClamperl at day with a Deep Sea Scale. Feebas at day with a Prism Scale.
it: \bClamperl di giorno con una Squamabissi. Feebas di giorno con una Squama Bella.

id: \bRhydon at day with a Protector. Magmar at day with a Magmarizer. Spritzee at day with a Sachet.
en: \bRhydon at day with a Protector. Magmar at day with a Magmarizer. Spritzee at day with a Sachet.
it: \bRhydon di giorno con un Copertura. Magmar di giorno con un Magmatore. Spritzee di giorno con una Bustina Aromi.

id: \bScyther evolves when holding a Metal Coat at night. Seadra at night with a Dragon Scale. Porygon2 at night with a Dubious Disk.
en: \bScyther evolves when holding a Metal Coat at night. Seadra at night with a Dragon Scale. Porygon2 at night with a Dubious Disk.
it: \bScyther si evolve di notte se tiene una Metalcoperta. Seadra di notte con una Squama Drago. Porygon2 di notte con un Dubbiodisco.

id: \bClamperl at night with a Deep Sea Tooth.
en: \bClamperl at night with a Deep Sea Tooth.
it: \bClamperl di notte con un Dente Abissi.

id: \bElectabuzz at night with an Electirizer. Dusclops at night with a Reaper Cloth. Swirlix at night with a Whipped Dream.
en: \bElectabuzz at night with an Electirizer. Dusclops at night with a Reaper Cloth. Swirlix at night with a Whipped Dream.
it: \bElectabuzz di notte con un Elettritore. Dusclops di notte con un Terrorpanno. Swirlix di notte con una Dolcespuma.

id: \bKarrablast evolves when Shelmet or Accelgor are in your party. Shelmet evolves when Karrablast or Escavalier are in your party.
en: \bKarrablast evolves when Shelmet or Accelgor are in your party. Shelmet evolves when Karrablast or Escavalier are in your party.
it: \bKarrablast si evolve quando Shelmet o Accelgor sono nella tua squadra. Shelmet si evolve quando Karrablast o Escavalier sono nella tua squadra.

id: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
en: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
it: \bTorna pure se vuoi saperne di più.

en: \rWhat? You don't remember me. We went to a summer camp at Professor Oak's lab when we were younger.

en: \rYou've always liked battling. Maybe having one will jog your memory.

id: \rYou remember me now right.

it: \rAdesso ti ricordi di me, vero?

en: \rOh right you came here for the gym. I'll get out of your way. I'll see you around \PN.
it: \rAh già, sei venuto qui per la Palestra. Mi tolgo di mezzo. Ci vediamo in giro, \PN.
